template_data.lead_html: Seven years in business. Certification in a folder. Zero federal contracts.

rows.what_html: WOSB certified — never connected to federal work — set-asides were an unknown opportunity
Set-aside competition: a fraction of open market — agencies required to hit WOSB award goals
Certification becomes a market filter — buyers actively looking for WOSB holders

template_data.closer: THE HARDEST PART? SHE'D ALREADY DONE IT.
